The layout labels columns: "Taxable", "VAT", "Amount" — so first numeric column (101.91) is taxable (net), VAT 0.00, and Amount 101.91. That maps to Net.Amount=101.91 and Vat.Amount=0.00. - All amounts have two decimals; keep them.
